title: 10 Stunning Decorative Mirrors That Double Your Space
excerpt: Mirrors aren't just functional — the right decorative mirror can make a room feel twice as big and infinitely more stylish.

props.text: Designers have used mirrors for centuries to fake square footage. By placing a large, stylized mirror opposite a window, you instantly bounce more natural light into the space and create the illusion of depth.
